什么是“海洋冰崖失稳”（MICI）机制？

What is the 'marine ice cliff instability' (MICI) mechanism?

当冰架退却、裸露的冰崖过高时，冰体因自身重力可能崩塌，暴露更内侧冰崖，形成自持退化，理论上可在百年尺度大幅抬升海平面。其触发阈值仍有争议。
When ice shelves retreat and expose overly tall ice cliffs, the ice can collapse under its own weight, exposing further cliffs and self-sustaining retreat—potentially raising seas substantially over centuries. Trigger thresholds remain debated.

#冰盖 #失稳 #海平面

格陵兰和南极冰盖融化会怎样影响海平面？

How do Greenland and Antarctic ice-sheet melt affect sea level?

冰盖陆地冰入海直接增加海水体积；此外质量损失改变重力与地壳回弹，使海平面分布不均。二者是当前海平面上升的主因之一。
Land ice entering the ocean directly adds volume; mass loss also shifts gravity and crustal rebound, making sea-level rise uneven. Both are leading causes of current rise.

#冰盖 #海平面 #南极

如果南极冰融化，海边的城市会怎样？

If Antarctic ice melts, what happens to coastal cities?

海水会变多、海平面上升，低洼的沿海城市更容易被淹、涨潮时更频繁进水。
More water means higher seas; low-lying coastal cities flood more easily and get seawater in more often at high tide.
